title: Signal: Optional dependency group with no version constraint
scope: A pyproject.toml file that declares an entry in an optional-dependencies group that names only the package.
limitations: It matches an entry in an optional-dependencies group that names only the package in the parsed pyproject.toml; it cannot tell whether the package is installed, whether any published version is affected by an advisory, or whether the dependency reaches production code.
fpNotes: A pyproject.toml that mentions an entry in an optional-dependencies group that names only the package in a comment, a documentation example or a template placeholder is not reported; the rule reads the parsed value that the installer acts on.
